snippet.title: Magenta Arcade II  - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
With your finger on the screen, become a vengeful deity and get ready to reclaim your kingdom!

From the creators of Dandara and Dandara: Trials of Fear Edition, comes Magenta Arcade II, a frantic shoot-'em-up where your own finger is the main character.

Instead of spaceships or avatars, you fire directly into the game world, transforming the screen into your personal battlefield. The eccentric scientist Eva Magenta and her family are ready to turn your followers against you—and only your touch can stop them.

📅 Launch Date: October 15, 2025
📲 Check out the game:
Google Play: http://longhathouse.com/ma2_googleplay
App Store: https://longhathouse.com/ma2_appstore

----------------------------------------

ABOUT THE GAME
- Innovative Touch Controls: Your finger is your weapon.
- Intense and Frantic Action: Bullets, explosions, and enemies that fill the screen.
- Comical Story and Memorable Characters: Face the Magenta family in unique battles.
- High Replayability: New challenges, secrets, and records in every session.

Whether you're a veteran of the first Magenta Arcade or a newcomer, this is a new standalone adventure: no need to have played the original.

----------------------------------------

SUPPORT
Magenta Arcade II is a project carried out with resources from the Paulo Gustavo Law (LC 195/2022), through the BH nas Telas – Edição Paulo Gustavo Call, promoted by the Municipal Secretariat of Culture of Belo Horizonte, Brazil.

----------------------------------------

#MagentaArcadeII #IndieGame #ShootEmUp #MobileGames #LongHatHouse
